units.source_text: 薰君看看八亲王的住处，觉得实在比传闻更为可怜。

en.t: When Lord Kaoru looked at Prince Hachi's dwelling, he found it even more pitiable than he had heard.

units.source_text: 自生活情状以至一切，都同想象中的草庵一样简陋。

en.t: From the manner of daily life to everything else, it was as plain and poor as the grass hut he had imagined.

units.source_text: 同样是称为山乡的地方，总有山乡独得而能牵惹人心的悠闲之趣。

en.t: Even among places called mountain villages, there is usually a special leisure and charm that belongs to such places and draws the heart.

units.source_text: 但此地水波之声响得可怕，竟至扰乱思想。

en.t: But here the sound of the water and waves rang so fearfully that it disturbed his very thoughts.

units.source_text: 晚间则风声凄厉，教人不能安心寻梦。

en.t: At night the wind sounded so desolate that one could not settle peacefully into dreams.

units.source_text: 学道之人住在这里，倒可借此消除对尘世的留恋之情。

en.t: For someone practicing the Way, living here might indeed help erase attachment to the dusty world.

units.source_text: 但小姐们在此度日，其心情又如何呢？

en.t: But what must the young ladies feel as they pass their days here?

units.source_text: 薰君推想她们缺乏世间普通女子的温柔之情。

en.t: Lord Kaoru imagined that they must lack the gentle feelings of ordinary women in the world.

units.source_text: 她们的房间和佛堂仅隔一道纸门。

en.t: Their rooms were separated from the Buddhist hall by only a single paper door.

units.source_text: 倘是好色之人，定会走近去窥探情状，渴望知道她们究竟生得如何模样。

en.t: A lustful man would surely have gone close to peer in and longed to know what they actually looked like.

units.source_text: 薰君虽亦偶有此心，但他总是立刻回心转意：“我来此的本意，是欲离弃俗世，探访深山。

en.t: Though Lord Kaoru sometimes had such thoughts too, he always immediately turned his mind back, saying to himself, My purpose in coming here is to leave the secular world and visit the deep mountains.

units.source_text: 如果说出无聊的好色之言，做出轻薄行为，便违反初志，失却本意了。”

en.t: If I were to speak foolish amorous words or behave frivolously, I would betray my original resolve and lose the purpose of my visit.

units.source_text: 因此他到这里，一味同情于八亲王的生涯，诚恳地向他慰问。

en.t: Therefore, whenever he came here, he simply felt sympathy for Prince Hachi's life and offered him sincere consolation.

units.source_text: 来的次数多了，始知八亲王正如他所预料，是个笼闭深山、专心学道的优婆塞。

en.t: After visiting many times, he came to see that Prince Hachi was just as he had expected, a lay Buddhist secluded deep in the mountains and devoted to the Way.

units.source_text: 他对于经文教义，并不装出精通的模样，却解释得非常清楚。

en.t: He did not pretend to be deeply learned in scriptures and doctrine, yet he explained them with remarkable clarity.

units.source_text: 圣僧模样的人和富有才学的法师，世间固然很多，

en.t: There were, of course, many people in the world who looked like holy monks, as well as learned priests.

units.source_text: 但过于超然离世、德高望重的僧都、僧正等，都很忙碌，又很矜持，未便轻易向他们请教佛法。

en.t: But eminent prelates and bishops who stood too far apart from the world and enjoyed great moral prestige were busy and proud, so it was not easy to ask them casually about the Buddhist law.

units.source_text: 反之，才德不高的佛弟子，则所可尊敬的只是确守戒律，

en.t: On the other hand, among Buddhist disciples of lesser talent and virtue, the only thing worthy of respect was their strict observance of the precepts.

units.source_text: 而这种人往往形容拙陋，语言乏味，凡庸村俗，相对毫无风趣。

en.t: Such people were often awkward in appearance, dull in speech, commonplace and rustic, and offered no charm in conversation.

units.source_text: 薰君白昼忙于公事，无有暇晷。

en.t: During the day Lord Kaoru was busy with official duties and had no free time at all.

units.source_text: 到了夜深人静之时，颇思召唤一人进入内室，于枕畔共谈佛法。

en.t: When night had deepened and all was quiet, he often wished to call someone into his private room and discuss the Buddhist law beside his pillow.

units.source_text: 但其人倘是此种佛弟子，则鄙陋不堪，毫无意味。

en.t: But if that person were one of those Buddhist disciples, he would be unbearably crude and there would be no pleasure in it.

units.source_text: 只有这位八亲王，人品高雅，深可敬爱。

en.t: Only this Prince Hachi was refined in character and deeply worthy of respect and affection.

units.source_text: 所说的话，虽然同是佛经教义，但能就近取譬，令人入耳易解。

en.t: Although what he spoke of was still Buddhist scripture and doctrine, he used familiar examples, making it pleasant to hear and easy to understand.

units.source_text: 他对于佛法，固然不是大彻大悟，但身份高贵之人，对于真理的理解自比常人更深。

en.t: He had not, of course, attained complete enlightenment in the Buddhist law, yet a person of noble birth naturally understood truth more deeply than ordinary people.

units.source_text: 薰君渐渐和他驯熟，每次相见，总想常侍左右。

en.t: Lord Kaoru gradually became familiar with him, and whenever they met, he always wished he could remain in attendance at his side.

units.source_text: 有时不得空闲，多时不来访问，便想念不置。

en.t: At times, when he had no leisure and could not visit for a long while, he found himself unable to stop thinking of him.
